title: Northgate Memberships Lapse, Closure and Suspension Periods
content:
The membership office applies four fixed periods to Northgate Memberships once a membership year ends unpaid or a membership is suspended. The figures are the same at every tier.

| Tier | Months after the expiry date within which a lapsed membership may be renewed and keep its anniversary | Months after the expiry date after which an unrenewed membership is closed | Cardholders of an expired membership may purchase merchandise | Days a suspension may stay uncleared before closure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 1 calendar month | 18 calendar months | No | 90 calendar days |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 2 calendar months | 18 calendar months | No | 90 calendar days |
| Northgate Club Membership | 2 calendar months | 18 calendar months | No | 90 calendar days |
| Northgate Business Membership | 2 calendar months | 18 calendar months | No | 90 calendar days |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 2 calendar months | 18 calendar months | No | 90 calendar days |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 2 calendar months | 18 calendar months | No | 90 calendar days |

## Meaning of each period

1. **Anniversary period.** How many calendar months after the expiry date a lapsed membership may be renewed and still keep its original anniversary: 1 month on the Student Club tier, 2 months on every other tier.
2. **Closure period.** The number of calendar months after the expiry date after which a membership that has not been renewed is closed: 18 months at every tier.
3. **Shopping while expired.** No tier allows the cardholders of an expired membership to purchase merchandise.
4. **Suspension period.** The number of calendar days a suspension may stay uncleared before the membership is closed: 90 days at every tier.

## Hypothetical comparison

For two memberships whose last membership year ended on the same day, one at the Student Club tier and one at the Club tier, the Student Club anniversary period ends one calendar month after the expiry date and the Club anniversary period two calendar months after it; both reach the 18-month closure period on the same day.
